content: The next best is a leader who is loved and praised. Next, one who is feared. The worst is one who is despised.
author: Lao Tzu
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Courage is rarely the thunderous heroics we see in movies; it is the quiet voice at the end of the day that says, 'I will try again tomorrow.' When we wait to feel completely fearless before taking a step, we stay trapped in place.

Lao Tzu understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. Real strength shows up with a racing pulse and trembling hands. It is the willingness to be vulnerable, to risk looking foolish, and to stand up for what matters even when everything in you wants to hide.
reflectionPrompt: What would change in your daily outlook if you truly lived by this perspective?
